Hi Stefan,

The data from the survey are now in the shared drive. I've cleaned up the duplicates and removed responses that were less than half complete, which left us with 412 usable responses.

The results on question 7 is surprising. Almost 60% of respondents said they would pay more for faster shipping.

Talk soon,
Mei

labels.notes: "The data ... are" is a valid (formal) plural usage and must not be flagged. The error is "results ... is".
